shadows.name: progress-dialog
shadows.purpose: Desktop-style progress window over the retained workspace.

motion.name: transfer-progress
motion.purpose: Real transfer progress only; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Native progress meter
components.description: Green, linear meter from the desktop progress window; progress comes from received/total bytes.
components.css: .ds-meter { height:16px; border:1px solid var(--dialog-line,#c8c8c8); border-radius:2px; background:var(--dialog-sheet,#f8f8f8); overflow:hidden; } .ds-meter span { display:block; height:100%; background:#098609; }

narrative.northStar: MDM desktop familiarity without losing web management capabilities
narrative.overview: The download list remains the operating surface. Sidebar administration opens dialogs. The progress window follows the owner's desktop visual reference rather than the previous wide web details panel.

rules.name: Evidence before decoration
rules.body: Connection segments and statistics use real server metadata. Never invent ping or unsupported completion controls.

dos: Keep settings and scheduler in the sidebar
Keep files on disk when clearing completed history
Preserve keyboard navigation and draft-race protection
donts: Replace desktop icons with generic folders
